definitions.explanation: Describes the state of not giving proper attention or care to something that deserves it. Often used to criticize lack of diligence or to express one's commitment to not neglect something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{疎|おろそ}かにして⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not neglect your studies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康管理|けんこうかんり}→健康管理：21662_kenkoukanri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{疎|おろそ}かにしがちだ。
examples.english: I tend to neglect health management.

examples.japanese: ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{疎|おろそ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you neglect the basics, you will fail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{疎|おろそ}かにして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反省|はんせい}した→反省する：21398_hanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I reflected on how I had been neglecting time with my family.

notes:
{疎|おろそ}か is typically used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to neglect something) or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become neglected).

Common patterns:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{疎|おろそ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to neglect something)
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{疎|おろそ}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (something becomes neglected)
- {疎|おろそ}かにしがち (tend to neglect)

Note: The kanji {疎|おろそ}か is often written in hiragana (おろそか) in everyday use.

Related words:
- ⟦{蔑|ないがしろ}→蔑：09446_naigashiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to neglect, disregard (stronger, more deliberate)
- ⟦{怠|なま}ける→怠ける：02379_namakeru⟧: to be lazy, slack off
- {軽視|けいし}する: to make light of, underestimate
